## Homemade gingerbread (perník)

Cup-measure gingerbread with no weighing: a mug and one bowl are all you need. With vanilla pudding powder and Dutch-process cocoa.

Rate this recipe

/ 5 ·

Mix used

- Gluten-free vanilla pudding powder

### Ingredients

- 3 cups plain flour (cup = 200 ml)
- 2 cups granulated sugar
- 1 cup oil
- 2 medium eggs
- 2 heaped tablespoons vanilla pudding powder
- 1 pack (about 20 g) gingerbread spice with raising agent
- 6 g baking powder (about 1½ teaspoons)
- 250 ml milk (1¼ cups)
- Dutch-process cocoa to taste

### Method

- Put all the ingredients into one bowl and mix thoroughly with an electric mixer until no lumps remain.
- Pour the batter onto a greased baking tray dusted with coarse flour.
- Bake in an oven preheated to 180 °C for 20–25 minutes (depending on tray depth).
- Test with a wooden skewer: it should come out clean, with no batter sticking to it.

Tip: add a little rum or rum flavouring, cinnamon, roughly chopped walnuts or chocolate to the batter.

### Frequently asked questions

*summary:* Do I need scales for the cup gingerbread?

No. Jiřina Jůzlová’s cup recipe: 10 minutes mixing, 20–25 minutes at 180 °C, 25–30 portions. The batter includes vanilla pudding powder and Dutch-process cocoa.

*summary:* How do I know the gingerbread is done?

A wooden skewer must come out clean, with no sticky batter.
